findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe eval/exec usage
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-eval
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe code execution operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe eval/exec usage in Pillow codebase

message.text: Potentially unsafe code execution operation that could execute arbitrary code.
Potentially unsafe code execution operation that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code execution functions in Pillow
 * @description Identify all eval/exec/compile usage in Pillow
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/code-execution-usage
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall()
select call, "Code execution function that could execute arbitrary code if untrusted input is used."
findings.hypothesis: Finding eval/exec/compile usage that could lead to code injection

message.text: Code execution function that could execute arbitrary code if untrusted input is used.
